prompt: How i can make Italian Napoleon pizza with Egyptian ingredient
response: To make an Italian Napoleon pizza with Egyptian ingredients, start with a pizza dough base and layer it with mozzarella cheese and Egyptian za'atar seasoning. Add sliced tomatoes and a sprinkle of sumac for a unique flavor. Bake until the cheese is melted and bubbly. This fusion of Italian and Egyptian flavors creates a unique and delicious pizza.
